Stub generator
* Consider providing the width of each input/output line as an input.

* Consider removing lines 9 to 14. An example output is unnecessary, as cases are shown in place of the statement in Reverse mode.

Cases
* The following cases don't have lines of consistent width:
  • A Few Turns (Test 5)
  • Where Does It Begin? (Test 9)

Thanks.
Good spot with the cases. I didn't really think the dimensions would be of use, I only gave the height for the stub generator, but I guess there's no reason not to include them.

Providing the width as an input can be useful for players who need to allocate memory for string arrays.

I noticed that Validator 10 is the only case where h > w. It'd be better to modify at least one test so that it has the same situation.
